title: Between Orion and the Streetlights
photoAlt: Stars above a palm tree in the night sky
caption: Light blinds me to the truth of darkness.
body:
This early morning, as I crossed the street, I saw a perfectly dark sky with no clouds. There were so many stars, a crescent moon, and my favourite, Orion. I felt far away from Earth. But every streetlight I passed pulled me back, again and again.

Then I smiled. Nothing can keep me from answering the call of the cosmos, not even the Sun. The day will come when nothing can pull me back to Earth.
question: Have you ever felt far from Earth, and what pulled you back?
